notes.title: Publisher's discount week
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone
[/h3]
We are happy to announce that Sapper - Defuse the Bomb Simulator is now playable on Steam in Early Access. The game was developed by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/livemotiongames]Live Motion Games Studio[/url] known for Train Station Renovation, Car Trader Simulator, and Gunslingers and Zombies. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3tHoHp9.png[/img]

Due to the release of the game, the publisher Gaming Factory S.A. announces a week of discounts. The games Gunsligners & Zombies and Gallic Wars: Battle Simulator players can buy at a mega attractive price.

[h3]You can learn more about the game here on its Steam page.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1083070/Sapper__Defuse_The_Bomb_Simulator/

By going to the Steam page of the game, you'll also be able to watch the developer tutorial played by one of our community managers! Don't worry if you didn't catch the beginning of the stream - it will stay looped for an extended period, so you can always jump in - whenever you feel like it! Ask us questions, chat with us, but most of all, check out the demo version of the game.

We would love to hear back from you as much as possible - if you have any ideas for the game, any feedback, or criticism - please let us know about it as we want to gather as much feedback as possible and make the game even better for its full release! 

Also, we will run Publisher Discount Week so You can grab Gallic Wars: Battle Simulator, Gunslingers and Zombies, and Sapper: Defuse the Bomb Simulator for a lower price.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1067760/Gallic_Wars_Battle_Simulator/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1059740/Gunslingers__Zombies/

Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/GTyR9ZC]Discord Server[/url], discuss with other Gamers and find out about upcoming games:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/GTyR9ZC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34901461/777f33df63be70dbd62d33a37aec47bdd1f5914a.png[/img][/url]

There are more giveaways on our Youtube DevStream!
[previewyoutube=lxtWfC6yDic;full][/previewyoutube]
